note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). A 30-point, 3-man recon card in every deck, 8 per deck. Russia: Razvedka, 3 AK-74M and 3 RPG-18; the old Razvedka card is renamed Razvedka Mech. US (Baltic too): Scouts, 3 M16A4 and 3 M72A3 LAW; the old Scouts card is renamed Scouts Stryker. Each new card is a copy of the old card (portrait, sensor, movement, Sprint Smoke Laser) with 3 men on the 3-man armor row of the same family. AK-74M for Razvedka is a guess (Osama named only the RPG-18). Each deck lends its transports from the pool named in transports_from. Not yet run in a game.
